environment: Real Supabase Storage API v1.98.6 + PostgreSQL 17 + GoTrue + PostgREST, disposable file backend; synthetic data only

tests.name: all four application buckets are private through the real Storage API
service uploads a private image with zero cache lifetime and exact bytes
anonymous and another authenticated user cannot read, upload, list or sign private objects despite a legacy permissive policy
private objects cannot be fetched through public URLs
signed private downloads return the original bytes
signed URLs expire at the real Storage origin
bucket MIME and size restrictions reject disallowed uploads
existing legacy bucket policies still work without exposing the application's private buckets
release ZIPs exist privately with hashes matching metadata for the browser checkout/download test
a synthetic school document exists privately for browser cross-school access checks
deleting a private object invalidates its previously signed URL at the origin

notes: Synthetic ZIP bytes are a test fixture, not a sale product.
Hosted Supabase/CDN and physical device acceptance are separate checks.
Signed URLs and credentials are excluded from this report.
